# Hans Albert

*1921 – 2023 · German*

A German philosopher and sociologist, the leading defender in Germany of [Popper](../philosophers/popper.md)'s critical rationalism. He argues that every attempt to give knowledge an ultimate foundation ends in a trilemma: infinite regress, circularity or arbitrary halt.
